A project manager doesn't write code or design. They establish the order in which the entire team works. The right sequence saves months of work and millions of rubles.

If you had to launch a video blog, what stages would your launch consist of?
Проджект-менеджер планирует, организовыв: A project manager plans, organizes, and controls project execution. They distribute tasks, manage deadlines and budgets, and are responsible for achieving results on schedule. They work a lot with plans, deadlines, and risks. The key skill for a specialist is to anticipate problems and solve them before they become a disaster.
Проджект-менеджер управляет людьми и зна:
A project manager works with people and knows there are many risks in communication. Some of them hide behind innocent phrases: 'I'll try', 'we decided in private', 'I'll work on it tonight'.

How often do you notice in your studies that the phrase 'everything's fine, I can handle it' actually means a call for help?

Тестировщики проверяют, как работает про: Testers check how the product works: they catch [bugs]{tooltip: "A bug is an error in a program."}, notice inconveniences, and collect glitches.
Тестовый стенд — отдельная копия приложе:
A test environment is a separate copy of the app where new functions are tested before showing to users.

A demo is a product presentation to a client or customer. Not a final version, but a stage of 'Look at what we have already'.
Техлид — мост между разработчиками и про: A tech lead is a bridge between developers and product. They translate business tasks into technical language and vice versa. They conduct retrospectives so the team works better with each cycle. They notice signs of burnout before they become a problem.
Технический менеджер (техлид) — связующе: A technical manager (tech lead) is a link between the development team and business. They understand code, but their main task is people. A tech lead notices problems before they become a disaster — through weak signals, not complaints.
Технический менеджер руководит командой: A technical manager leads a team of developers: distributes tasks, monitors the pace of work, and helps solve technical problems. They participate in sprint planning, conduct retrospectives, and ensure technical solutions align with business goals.
Технический руководитель команды разрабо: A technical leader of a development team. They are responsible not only for code and architecture but also for the well-being of people in the team.
Точно. Пользователь открывает приложение: Right. The user opens the app to order food, not to photograph it. That's a feature for another product. A good backlog always solves real problems.
